summary: E2E operational verification of NowKart delivery lifecycle — all 43 tests passed in 1.76s. Covered full delivery flow: job creation via webhook, admin views/transitions, rider assignment, rider GPS contract, push-token registration, complete state machine (assigned→delivered), event trail integrity, multi-vendor separation, customer auth gate, and regression checks.
critical_code_review_comments: deliveryAddress.coordinates and pickupAddress.coordinates are null — ETA/geocoding module not yet implemented. Rider App Maps must handle null gracefully (fall back to address text). Documented as known gap, not a blocker.

Dedicated rider-action endpoints (POST /api/rider/job/{id}/at-store etc.) do not exist — state transitions use PUT /api/delivery/jobs/{jobId}/status with actor=rider:{id}. Noted for future Rider App backend addition.
Customer tracking GET /api/tracking/order requires Shopify OAuth and cannot be tested without a native build — out of scope for this test run.
seed_data_creation: Synthetic test rider, two vendors, one legacy job, one multi-vendor job created and cleaned up within the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 43 E2E delivery lifecycle tests pass cleanly. Known gaps: coordinates=null (no geocoding), no dedicated rider-action endpoints, Shopify OAuth customer tracking untestable. No regressions detected.
